DISHA / DIRECT UPI CHECKOUT

Prepare your payment.

Choose the receiving account type, enter your details and continue to the actual UPI checkout.

Payment type

P2P uses the configured personal receiving account. The receiving handle must be authorized on DISHA.

The next page issues one time-limited payment request. DISHA never asks for your UPI PIN. P2M access requires an approved merchant account and bank-issued MCC.
